headline: Canada joins EuroHPC as its 39th participating state
summary: On 30 October 2026, Canada became the 39th participating state in the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking, which pools public resources for supercomputing and related research. EuroHPC and the European Commission say Canadian scientists will be able to access European HPC, AI and quantum resources. EuroHPC’s current Regular Access call states that organizations in Horizon Europe-associated countries may apply for post-2020 EuroHPC supercomputers; the Commission says Canada has been associated with Horizon Europe since 2024. Applications remain subject to the call’s employment, review and formal-allocation requirements. No Canadian award, usage or resulting research or economic outcome was inspected.
